code:
-- After an in-place major upgrade, this does NOT exist:
--   "downgrade database back to old version"

-- SQL Server will not attach/restore a newer-version
-- backup onto an older-version instance.

-- Real rollback = restore the PRE-UPGRADE backup
-- onto a SEPARATE instance still on the old version.
caption: No pre-upgrade backup + no old-version instance = no rollback.
